title: Notes Written on Substack
contentHTML:
A calm reading surface gives the words enough room to establish their own rhythm without adding another layer of interface.

Substack writes its footnote number as a bare link, with no superscript around it1, and puts the note in its own block at the end of the post.

A calm reading surface gives the words enough room to establish their own rhythm without adding another layer of interface.

1

A note that opens under its own line.

Its second paragraph stays with it.
